notes.listingStatus: Not stored directly — computed from quantity + purchasePrice. quantity=1 & purchasePrice set => Purchased. quantity=0 & purchasePrice set => Pending Delivery. quantity=0 & no purchasePrice => Wanted.
notes.colorFamilyTypeCollection: color is a fixed multi-select (see 'colors' above — cards can be dual-color, e.g. Red+Green). familyType and collection are free-text multi-value tags (no fixed list — familyType covers the game's many crew/faction 'Feature' tags, too numerous and prone-to-drift to hardcode correctly; collection is open-ended by nature). All three store as arrays even when only one value is picked, and join with ' + ' for xlsx import/export.
